supplementation of Mn in the diet can improve the digestability and fermentation pattern.

supplementation of Mn in the diet of cattle can improve the nutrient utilization and fermentation pattern in the rumen.
Mn supplementation in the diet of ruminants is essential to improve the nutrient utilization and rumen fermentation.
